subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should default run-mode subagent sessions be preserved as history after terminal cleanup, or should OpenClaw auto-hide/archive/delete them as ephemeral work by default?
rationale: Current code deliberately preserves run-mode sessions by default, and changing that affects transcript retention, attachments, task reconciliation, session list semantics, and Control UI/WebChat expectations.

options.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
options.body: Keep completed run-mode subagent transcripts by default, but make session/task lists and WebChat status immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking.

options.title: Auto-Archive/Delete Run Children
options.body: Make one-shot subagents ephemeral by default, accepting a retention behavior change that needs migration, docs, and fresh/upgrade proof.

options.title: Add A Retention Policy
options.body: Introduce an explicit retention setting only if maintainers decide existing cleanup, status, and doctor behavior cannot express the desired contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep completed run-mode subagent transcripts by default, but make session/task lists and WebChat status immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is ownership of the subagent registry lifecycle/run-manager split and recent registry maintenance.
